title: Direct Deposit Regularity Schedule — Pocketwire Advance Late Fee Relief
content:
For the payroll-delay relief on a Pocketwire Advance line, the regularity of the customer's payroll is read from the direct deposits into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account. When the linked personal account received at least 12 direct deposits totalling at least six times the monthly direct deposit requirement of the line's tier in the six months before the handling date, 0.10 is added to the relief share; when it received at least 6 direct deposits totalling at least three times that requirement in that window without meeting both parts of the higher test, 0.05 is added to the relief share; otherwise the payroll record adds nothing to the relief share. The relief share is the fraction of the late fee that the relief returns.

**The window.** A window of six months before the handling date covers the records dated after the same day of the month six months before the handling date, up to and including the handling date. With a hypothetical handling date of 25 September, the window holds the direct deposits dated after 25 March up to and including 25 September.

**What is counted.** The direct deposit entries on the ledger of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account dated in the window: their number and their total.

## Thresholds by tier

| Tier of the line | Monthly direct deposit requirement | Higher test: total of at least six times it | Lower test: total of at least three times it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 300.00 | 1800.00 | 900.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 500.00 | 3000.00 | 1500.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 800.00 | 4800.00 | 2400.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 1200.00 | 7200.00 | 3600.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 1800.00 | 10800.00 | 5400.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 2500.00 | 15000.00 | 7500.00 |

The higher test needs at least 12 deposits and the higher total; the lower test needs at least 6 deposits and the lower total.

## Combinations (hypothetical line on Pocketwire Advance Standard)

| Deposits in the window | Total in the window | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 4800.00 | 0.10 — both parts of the higher test |
| 13 | 3000.00 | 0.05 — total below 4800.00 but at least 2400.00 |
| 8 | 5200.00 | 0.05 — fewer than 12 deposits, at least 6 |
| 5 | 6000.00 | Nothing — fewer than 6 deposits |
| 10 | 2300.00 | Nothing — total below 2400.00 |
